item.text: {"status":"math_error","independent_answer":"2 pills per day.","check":"After (4/5) × 30 = 24 days, 6 days remain, so the daily dose is 12 ÷ 6 = 2 pills. The correct balance is 30x = 12 + 24x, not 6x = 12 + x.","evidence_quote":"This means he has taken pills for 1/5 of the days.","error_description":"The solution incorrectly treats the remaining one-fifth of the days as elapsed days. It then misidentifies the total and consumed pill quantities in its equation, producing an incorrect daily dose."}
